current_example.problem: Construct the truth table of the statement $(A \land B) \lor (A \lor B).$
current_example.worked_solution:
First, we complete a truth table for the first part in parentheses, $A \land B.$ The statement $A \land B$ is true if both $A$ and $B$ are true.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A \land B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ |

Next, we append the truth table for the second part in parentheses, $A \lor B.$ The statement $A \lor B$ is true if either $A$ is true, $B$ is true, or both $A$ and $B$ are true. 

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A \land B\,$ | $\,A \lor B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ |

Finally, we look at the columns labeled $(A \land B)$ and $(A \lor B)$ to complete the column $(A \land B) \lor (A \lor B).$ The statement $(A \land B) \lor (A \lor B)$ is true if either $(A \land B)$ is true, $(A \lor B)$ is true, or both $(A \land B)$ and $(A \lor B)$ are true. 

The completed truth table is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A \land B\,$ | $\, A \lor B\,$ | $\,(A \land B) \lor (A \lor B)  \,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\textrm T}$ |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\textrm T}$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\textrm T}$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\textrm F}$ |
